property_summary: For any configured role (TIMELOCK/PROPOSER/EXECUTOR), getRoleAdmin must return the stored admin role TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE; the mutant returns DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE instead, differing whenever TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE != DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (always).
change_summary: Always return DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE instead of the stored adminRole mapping value.
